title: Concept: npm client installs with a floating range by default
description: .npmrc declares a client setting that writes a caret range when a dependency is added, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Every added dependency starts out accepting unreviewed patch and minor releases, so the manifest drifts away from the version that was tested.
risk: Every added dependency starts out accepting unreviewed patch and minor releases, so the manifest drifts away from the version that was tested.
